title: Why Do Flamingos Stand on One Leg?
speaker: SciShow
zh: 【SciShow】火烈鳥為什麼要用單腳站立？（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Thanks to Brilliant for supporting this episode of SciShow.
cues.en: Thanks to Brilliant for supporting this episode of SciShow.
cues.zh: 感謝 Brilliant 對本期 SciShow 的支援。

cues.text: Go to Brilliant.org/SciShow to learn how you can take your STEM skills to the next level!
cues.en: Go to Brilliant.org/SciShow to learn how you can take your STEM skills to the next level!
cues.zh: 請造訪 Brilliant.org/SciShow 以瞭解如何將您的 STEM 技能提升到新的水平！

cues.text: If you’re a fan of lawn ornaments, maybe you just live in the state of Florida,
cues.en: If you’re a fan of lawn ornaments, maybe you just live in the state of Florida,
cues.zh: 如果您是草坪裝飾的粉絲，也許您住在佛羅裡達州，

cues.text: you might have a plastic flamingo or two.
cues.en: you might have a plastic flamingo or two.
cues.zh: 你可能有一兩隻塑膠火烈鳥。

cues.text: If you do, there’s a pretty good chance that it’s pink, it’s a little bit tacky,
cues.en: If you do, there’s a pretty good chance that it’s pink, it’s a little bit tacky,
cues.zh: 如果你這樣做，它很可能是粉紅色的，有點俗氣，

cues.text: and, of course, it’s standing on one leg.
cues.en: and, of course, it’s standing on one leg.
cues.zh: 當然，它是用一條腿站立的。

cues.text: And I’m not saying this as an insult: real flamingos are also pink,
cues.en: And I’m not saying this as an insult: real flamingos are also pink,
cues.zh: 我這麼說並不是侮辱：真正的紅鶴也是粉紅色的，

cues.text: a little tacky in an “evolutionarily oopsie” sort of way,
cues.en: a little tacky in an “evolutionarily oopsie” sort of way,
cues.zh: 有點俗氣，有點“進化上的糟糕”，

cues.text: and often they are found standing on one leg.
cues.en: and often they are found standing on one leg.
cues.zh: 人們經常發現他們單腳站立。

cues.text: And I’m not here to criticize them.
cues.en: And I’m not here to criticize them.
cues.zh: 我不是來批評他們的。

cues.text: If you asked me to stand on one leg all day long every day, like,
cues.en: If you asked me to stand on one leg all day long every day, like,
cues.zh: 如果你讓我每天整天單腳站立，例如，

cues.text: my days would need to be shorter.
cues.en: my days would need to be shorter.
cues.zh: 我的日子需要更短。

cues.text: So, what is it that makes flamingos different?
cues.en: So, what is it that makes flamingos different?
cues.zh: 那麼，是什麼讓火烈鳥與眾不同呢？

cues.text: Why are they the one-legged champions of nature?
cues.en: Why are they the one-legged champions of nature?
cues.zh: 為什麼他們是自然的單足冠軍？

cues.text: For a long time, people kind of just assumed that flamingos did this to conserve heat.
cues.en: For a long time, people kind of just assumed that flamingos did this to conserve heat.
cues.zh: 很長一段時間，人們都認為火烈鳥這樣做是為了儲存熱量。

cues.text: In fact, that’s what we thought when we did our first episode on why flamingoes stand on one leg.
cues.en: In fact, that’s what we thought when we did our first episode on why flamingoes stand on one leg.
cues.zh: 事實上，這就是我們在製作第一集關於火烈鳥為什麼單腳站立時的想法。

cues.text: Which we are now taking down off the internet.
cues.en: Which we are now taking down off the internet.
cues.zh: 我們現在正在將其從網際網路上刪除。

cues.text: It makes sense to think this; cats do something similar, informally called “loafing,” when they tuck their limbs in
cues.en: It makes sense to think this; cats do something similar, informally called “loafing,” when they tuck their limbs in
cues.zh: 這樣想是有道理的；當貓把四肢塞進去時，它們也會做類似的事情，非正式地稱為“閒逛”

cues.text: to make themselves look like a loaf of bread.
cues.en: to make themselves look like a loaf of bread.
cues.zh: 讓自己看起來像一條麵包。

cues.text: And they might do this because it stops them from losing heat in their extremities.
cues.en: And they might do this because it stops them from losing heat in their extremities.
cues.zh: 他們這樣做可能是因為這可以阻止他們四肢失去熱量。

cues.text: But that explanation... it did not make sense to bird researchers.
cues.en: But that explanation... it did not make sense to bird researchers.
cues.zh: 但這種解釋……對鳥類研究人員來說沒有意義。

cues.text: See, some birds have a network of closely-packed blood vessels in their legs that are really good at recapturing and conserving body heat.
cues.en: See, some birds have a network of closely-packed blood vessels in their legs that are really good at recapturing and conserving body heat.
cues.zh: 你看，有些鳥類的腿部有一個緊密排列的血管網路，非常擅長重新捕獲和儲存體溫。

cues.text: So they already conserve heat naturally without having to resort to behaviors like loafing.
cues.en: So they already conserve heat naturally without having to resort to behaviors like loafing.
cues.zh: 因此，它們已經自然地儲存熱量，而不必採取諸如遊蕩之類的行為。

cues.text: But here’s the really weird bit: like your plastic lawn ornament, a flamingo doesn’t actually have to be alive
cues.en: But here’s the really weird bit: like your plastic lawn ornament, a flamingo doesn’t actually have to be alive
cues.zh: 但真正奇怪的是：就像你的塑膠草坪裝飾一樣，火烈鳥其實不一定是活的

cues.text: to successfully maintain a one-legged standing position.
cues.en: to successfully maintain a one-legged standing position.
cues.zh: 成功地保持單腳站立姿勢。

cues.text: That somewhat horrible truth is the result of one very weird experiment.
cues.en: That somewhat horrible truth is the result of one very weird experiment.
cues.zh: 這個有點可怕的事實是一個非常奇怪的實驗的結果。

cues.text: Researchers were compelled to ask this macabre question because they knew that flamingos will often sleep
cues.en: Researchers were compelled to ask this macabre question because they knew that flamingos will often sleep
cues.zh: 研究人員被迫問這個可怕的問題，因為他們知道火烈鳥經常睡覺

cues.text: while standing on one leg.
cues.en: while standing on one leg.
cues.zh: 單腳站立時。

cues.text: Which would be exceedingly difficult if it wasn’t something that came really, really easily to them.
cues.en: Which would be exceedingly difficult if it wasn’t something that came really, really easily to them.
cues.zh: 如果這對他們來說不是非常非常容易的事情，那麼這將是極其困難的。

cues.text: I mean, like, have you even ever tried to prop up your own head while sleeping on an airplane?
cues.en: I mean, like, have you even ever tried to prop up your own head while sleeping on an airplane?
cues.zh: 我的意思是，你有沒有嘗試過在飛機上睡覺時支撐自己的頭？

cues.text: Like, you can’t even do that without...gah.
cues.en: Like, you can’t even do that without...gah.
cues.zh: 就像，如果沒有……你甚至無法做到這一點。

cues.text: But as it turns out, flamingos don’t have to invest that much muscle power to stay upright.
cues.en: But as it turns out, flamingos don’t have to invest that much muscle power to stay upright.
cues.zh: 但事實證明，火烈鳥不需要投入那麼多的肌肉力量來保持直立。

cues.text: Scientists confirmed this by taking dead flamingos and propping them back up on one leg.
cues.en: Scientists confirmed this by taking dead flamingos and propping them back up on one leg.
cues.zh: 科學家們透過取出死去的火烈鳥並將它們用一條腿支撐起來證實了這一點。

cues.text: Which makes you wonder what they say when people ask them what they do for a living at a party.
cues.en: Which makes you wonder what they say when people ask them what they do for a living at a party.
cues.zh: 這讓你想知道當人們在聚會上問他們以什麼為生時他們會說什麼。

cues.text: If this sounds weird, though, it actually is probably a little bit more kind to use a cadaver than it would be to wrangle a live bird like this.
cues.en: If this sounds weird, though, it actually is probably a little bit more kind to use a cadaver than it would be to wrangle a live bird like this.
cues.zh: 不過，如果這聽起來很奇怪，那麼實際上使用屍體可能比像這樣糾纏一隻活鳥更仁慈。

cues.text: They discovered that a fresh, floppy flamingo corpse was quite stable on one leg, despite, you know, being dead.
cues.en: They discovered that a fresh, floppy flamingo corpse was quite stable on one leg, despite, you know, being dead.
cues.zh: 他們發現一具新鮮的、鬆軟的火烈鳥屍體的一條腿相當穩定，儘管你知道，它已經死了。

cues.text: The most stable position was with the foot directly beneath the bird
cues.en: The most stable position was with the foot directly beneath the bird
cues.zh: 最穩定的位置是將腳放在鳥的正下方

cues.text: at the precise angle that triggers the joint lock that stops the bird from toppling over while sleeping.
cues.en: at the precise angle that triggers the joint lock that stops the bird from toppling over while sleeping.
cues.zh: 以精確的角度觸發關節鎖，防止鳥兒在睡覺時翻倒。

cues.text: Basically, it’s a system that’s based on gravity.
cues.en: Basically, it’s a system that’s based on gravity.
cues.zh: 基本上，這是一個基於重力的系統。

cues.text: The flamingo’s center of mass is in just the right place, in front of its knee, and the knee itself can only move in a limited way.
cues.en: The flamingo’s center of mass is in just the right place, in front of its knee, and the knee itself can only move in a limited way.
cues.zh: 火烈鳥的質心正好位於正確的位置，在它的膝蓋前面，而膝蓋本身只能以有限的方式移動。

cues.text: So when the foot is placed at just the right angle, the flamingo’s weight is all that’s needed to lock the joints in its leg,
cues.en: So when the foot is placed at just the right angle, the flamingo’s weight is all that’s needed to lock the joints in its leg,
cues.zh: 因此，當腳以正確的角度放置時，火烈鳥的重量就足以鎖定腿部的關節，

cues.text: thus making it possible for even a dead flamingo to stand on one leg with minimal assistance.
cues.en: thus making it possible for even a dead flamingo to stand on one leg with minimal assistance.
cues.zh: 因此，即使是一隻死去的火烈鳥也可以在最少的幫助下單腳站立。

cues.text: And, when propped up on two legs, the cadavers weren’t stable at all,
cues.en: And, when propped up on two legs, the cadavers weren’t stable at all,
cues.zh: 而且，用兩條腿支撐時，屍體根本不穩定，

cues.text: so that was a nice little bow to wrap on their very weird study.
cues.en: so that was a nice little bow to wrap on their very weird study.
cues.zh: 所以這是一個很好的小鞠躬來結束他們非常奇怪的研究。

cues.text: They did also test their theory on live flamingos, by the way, but more gently.
cues.en: They did also test their theory on live flamingos, by the way, but more gently.
cues.zh: 順便說一句，他們也在活火烈鳥身上測試了他們的理論，但更加溫和。

cues.text: They had their living subjects stand on force plates, devices that measure the forces generated by movement,
cues.en: They had their living subjects stand on force plates, devices that measure the forces generated by movement,
cues.zh: 他們讓活體受試者站在測力板上，這是一種測量運動產生的力量的裝置，

cues.text: and then waited for them to fall asleep.
cues.en: and then waited for them to fall asleep.
cues.zh: 然後等他們睡著了。

cues.text: The force plate data told the researchers what was happening in the flamingo’s foot when its body was in motion,
cues.en: The force plate data told the researchers what was happening in the flamingo’s foot when its body was in motion,
cues.zh: 測力板資料告訴研究人員當火烈鳥的身體運動時，其腳部發生了什麼，

cues.text: during both active and quiet moments.
cues.en: during both active and quiet moments.
cues.zh: 在活躍和安靜的時刻。

cues.text: The live flamingos were extremely stable on one leg, with the flamingo's center of gravity held just-so over its leg,
cues.en: The live flamingos were extremely stable on one leg, with the flamingo's center of gravity held just-so over its leg,
cues.zh: 活生生的火烈鳥單腳非常穩定，火烈鳥的重​​心正好保持在它的腿上，

cues.text: kind of like an upside down pendulum.
cues.en: kind of like an upside down pendulum.
cues.zh: 有點像是倒立的鐘擺。

cues.text: So what’s up with this?
cues.en: So what’s up with this?
cues.zh: 那麼這是怎麼回事呢？

cues.text: Well, the one legged posture saves energy, and is just easier for the birds.
cues.en: Well, the one legged posture saves energy, and is just easier for the birds.
cues.zh: 嗯，單腿姿勢可以節省能量，對鳥類來說更容易。

cues.text: In short, flamingos, whether alive, dead, or plastic,
cues.en: In short, flamingos, whether alive, dead, or plastic,
cues.zh: 簡而言之，火烈鳥，無論是活的、死的還是塑膠的，

cues.text: are perfectly adapted to standing on one leg, and that’s just fine by them.
cues.en: are perfectly adapted to standing on one leg, and that’s just fine by them.
cues.zh: 非常適合單腳站立，這對他們來說很好。

cues.text: You thought this episode was going to be about biology, when it’s mostly about the physics of flamingo joints!
cues.en: You thought this episode was going to be about biology, when it’s mostly about the physics of flamingo joints!
cues.zh: 你以為這集是關於生物學的，其實它主要是關於火烈鳥關節的物理學！

cues.text: But worry not!
cues.en: But worry not!
cues.zh: 但不用擔心！

cues.text: If your physics skills could use some help, there is Brilliant.
cues.en: If your physics skills could use some help, there is Brilliant.
cues.zh: 如果你的物理技能需要一些幫助，那就是 Brilliant。

cues.text: Like their course “Physics of the Everyday,” though whether or not flamingos are everyday
cues.en: Like their course “Physics of the Everyday,” though whether or not flamingos are everyday
cues.zh: 就像他們的課程“日常物理學”一樣，儘管火烈鳥是否是日常的

cues.text: depends a bit on where you live.
cues.en: depends a bit on where you live.
cues.zh: 有點取決於你住在哪裡。

cues.text: They’ve got 60-plus interactive courses on math, basic science,
cues.en: They’ve got 60-plus interactive courses on math, basic science,
cues.zh: 他們有 60 多門互動課程，涉及數學、基礎科學、

cues.text: and computer science too, so you can cover as many of those gaps as you want.
cues.en: and computer science too, so you can cover as many of those gaps as you want.
cues.zh: 以及電腦科學，因此您可以根據需要彌補盡可能多的空白。

cues.en: If you’re interested, you can check out Brilliant.org/scishow for a chance to get 20% off an annual Premium subscription.
cues.zh: 如果您有興趣，可以造訪 Brilliant.org/scishow，有機會獲得年度高階訂閱 20% 的折扣。

cues.text: And thank you for your support.
cues.en: And thank you for your support.
cues.zh: 感謝您的支援。
